    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.7.1/jquery.min.js"></script>

    <script>
        window.addEventListener('load', loader);


        function getCookie(name) {
            const cookies = document.cookie.split(';');

            for (const c of cookies) {
                const [key, value] = c.trim().split('=');
                if (key === name) {
                    return value;
                }
            }
            return null;
        }



        function loader() {
            setTimeout(() => {
                document.querySelector('.huawei-header-offer').classList.add('active');
            }, 2000)
            setTimeout(() => {
                document.querySelector('.huawei-logo').classList.add('active');
            }, 6000)

            const deb = getCookie("SRP");

            // Si cookie inexistant OU vide
            if (!deb) {
                console.log("Utilisateur non connecté, SRP vide ou inexistant.");

                const newURLMob = "https://www.showroomprive.com/default.aspx?direction=ope%2Fminisite.aspx%3Fvente%3D155102 ";
                const newURLDesk = "https://www.showroomprive.com/?direction=ope%2Fminisite.aspx%3Fvente%3D155102";

                const ctas = document.querySelectorAll('.huawei-cta');

                ctas.forEach(cta => {
                    // On supprime l’onclick existant
                    cta.removeAttribute('onclick');

                    if (window.matchMedia('(max-width: 767px)').matches) {
                        cta.addEventListener('click', () => {
                            window.location.href = newURLMob;
                        });
                    } else {
                        // Nouvelle redirection
                        cta.addEventListener('click', () => {
                            window.location.href = newURLDesk;
                        });
                    }

                });
            } else {
                console.log("Utilisateur connecté, valeur du cookie SRP :", deb);
            }

        }



        // COPIE CODE
        function copy(e) {
            const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
            const code = e.querySelector('.huawei-code');
            const codeConfirm = e.querySelector('.huawei-code-confirm');

            textarea.setAttribute('readonly', true);
            document.body.appendChild(textarea);
            textarea.value = code.innerText;
            textarea.select();
            document.execCommand('copy');
            textarea.remove();

            code.style.transform = "scale(.9)";
            setTimeout(function() {
                code.style.transform = "scale(1)";
            }, 300);

            setTimeout(function() {
                codeConfirm.classList.add("actif");

            }, 500);
            setTimeout(function() {
                codeConfirm.classList.remove("actif");
            }, 1500);

        }
        // eo: COPIE CODE



        let isFitActive = false;

        function updateAllOnclicks(isActive) {
            if (isActive) {
                // État FIT
                document.querySelector('.huawei-changing-bloc-code-1').setAttribute('onclick', "copy(this), tag('155102|COPIECODEFIT')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-changing-cta-1').setAttribute('onclick', "redirectPartner('https://consumer.huawei.com/fr/wearables/watch-fit5-pro/buy/?productId=18033072542285', '155102|CTAJENPROFITEFIT')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-switch-button').setAttribute('onclick', "tag('155102|TOGGLEWATCHFIT')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-changing-bloc-code-2').setAttribute('onclick', "copy(this), tag('155102|COPIECODESELECTIONFIT')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-changing-cta-2').setAttribute('onclick', "redirectPartner('https://consumer.huawei.com/fr/wearables/watch-fit5-pro/buy/?productId=18033072542285', '155102|CTASELECTIONFIT')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-plus-1').setAttribute('onclick', "tag('155102|PLUSFITDESIGNFIN')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-plus-2').setAttribute('onclick', "tag('155102|PLUSFITAUTONOMIE')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-plus-3').setAttribute('onclick', "tag('155102|PLUSFITMINIENTRAINEMENT')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-plus-4').setAttribute('onclick', "tag('155102|PLUSFITNFC')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-changing-cta-3').setAttribute('onclick', "redirectPartner('https://consumer.huawei.com/fr/wearables/watch-fit5-pro/buy/?productId=18033072542285', '155102|CTAAVANTAGESFIT')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-switch-sticky').setAttribute('onclick', "tag('155102|SWITCHFITSTICKY')");
                document.querySelector('.sticky-flexbox').setAttribute('onclick', "redirectPartner('https://consumer.huawei.com/fr/wearables/watch-fit5-pro/buy/?productId=18033072542285', '155102|CTASTICKY')");
            } else {
                // État PRO (retour à l'état initial)
                document.querySelector('.huawei-changing-bloc-code-1').setAttribute('onclick', "copy(this), tag('155102|COPIECODEFITPRO')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-changing-cta-1').setAttribute('onclick', "redirectPartner('https://consumer.huawei.com/fr/wearables/watch-fit5-pro/buy/', '155102|CTAJENPROFITEFITPRO')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-switch-button').setAttribute('onclick', "tag('155102|TOGGLEWATCHFITPRO')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-changing-bloc-code-2').setAttribute('onclick', "copy(this), tag('155102|COPIECODESELECTIONFITPRO')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-changing-cta-2').setAttribute('onclick', "redirectPartner('https://consumer.huawei.com/fr/wearables/watch-fit5-pro/buy/', '155102|CTASELECTIONFITPRO')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-plus-1').setAttribute('onclick', "tag('155102|PLUSFITPROVERRESAPHIR')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-plus-2').setAttribute('onclick', "tag('155102|PLUSFITPROAUTONOMIE')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-plus-3').setAttribute('onclick', "tag('155102|PLUSFITPRONFC')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-plus-4').setAttribute('onclick', "tag('155102|PLUSFITPROSUIVISANTE')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-changing-cta-3').setAttribute('onclick', "redirectPartner('https://consumer.huawei.com/fr/wearables/watch-fit5-pro/buy/', '155102|CTAAVANTAGESFITPRO')");
                document.querySelector('.huawei-switch-sticky').setAttribute('onclick', "tag('155102|SWITCHFITPROSTICKY')");
                document.querySelector('.sticky-flexbox').setAttribute('onclick', "redirectPartner('https://consumer.huawei.com/fr/wearables/watch-fit5-pro/buy/', '155102|CTASTICKYPRO')");
            }
        }




        $(document).ready(function() {



            mySwiperFitPro = new Swiper('.swiper-fit-five-pro', {
                loop: false,
                slidesPerView: 1,
                a11y: true,
                speed: 750,
                effect: 'fade',
                pagination: {
                    el: ".pagination-fit-five-pro",
                    clickable: true,
                },
            });

            mySwiperFit = new Swiper('.swiper-fit-five', {
                loop: false,
                slidesPerView: 1,
                a11y: true,
                speed: 750,
                effect: 'fade',
                pagination: {
                    el: ".pagination-fit-five",
                    clickable: true,
                },
            });








            const dots = document.querySelectorAll(".huawei-plus");
            const texts = document.querySelectorAll(".huawei-appearing-txt");

            dots.forEach((dot, index) => {
                dot.addEventListener("click", () => {
                    // On toggle la visibilité du texte correspondant
                    texts[index].classList.add("active");
                    dots[index].classList.add("active");
                });
            });
            texts.forEach((text, index) => {
                text.addEventListener("click", () => {
                    // On toggle la visibilité du texte correspondant
                    texts[index].classList.remove("active");
                    dots[index].classList.remove("active");
                });
            });



            const huaweiSwitch = document.querySelector(".huawei-switch-button");
            const huaweiChanges = document.querySelectorAll(".huawei-changing-color");
            const huaweiSwitchSticky = document.querySelector(".huawei-switch-sticky");

            function toggleSwitch() {
                huaweiChanges.forEach(huaweiChange => {
                    huaweiChange.classList.toggle("active");
                });
                isFitActive = !isFitActive;
                updateAllOnclicks(isFitActive); // ← appelé seulement ici
            }

            huaweiSwitch.addEventListener("click", toggleSwitch);
            huaweiSwitchSticky.addEventListener("click", toggleSwitch);




            // STICKY
            function ctaSticky(opSticky, opStickyCont) {
                let stickyHeight = opSticky.outerHeight();
                opStickyCont.outerHeight(stickyHeight);
                opSticky.addClass("sticky-transform0");

                window.addEventListener("scroll", function() {
                    if ($(window).scrollTop() <= opStickyCont.offset().top + opSticky
                        .outerHeight() - $(
                            window)
                        .height()) {
                        opSticky.addClass("sticky");
                    } else {
                        opSticky.removeClass("sticky");
                    }

                    if (window.pageYOffset >
                        700
                    ) {
                        opSticky.removeClass("sticky-transform0");
                    } else {
                        opSticky.addClass("sticky-transform0");
                    }
                });
            }
            ctaSticky($(".op-sticky"), $(".op-sticky-cont"));
            // eo: CTA Sticky

        });
    </script>

@font-face {
  font-family: "Huawei-light";
  src: url("./HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Light.ttf");
}
@font-face {
  font-family: "Huawei-regular";
  src: url("./HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf");
}
@font-face {
  font-family: "Huawei-medium";
  src: url("./HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Medium.ttf");
}
@font-face {
  font-family: "Huawei-bold";
  src: url("./HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Bold.ttf");
}
@font-face {
  font-family: "Huawei-black";
  src: url("./HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Black.ttf");
}
:root {
  --huawei-blue: #75B2D1;
  --huawei-purple: #E7CCFF;
  --tpl-medium-dark: #5D5D5D;
  --tpl-medium: #E4E4E4;
  --tpl-light: #F3F3F1;
}
@media (prefers-color-theme: dark) {
  :root[data-theme=dark] {
    --tpl-principale: #FF5B55;
    --tpl-dark: black;
    --tpl-medium-dark: #5D5D5D;
    --tpl-medium: #E4E4E4;
    --tpl-light: #F3F3F1;
  }
}

.lp-huawei {
  text-align: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: white;
  color: black;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  font-family: "Huawei-regular", sans-serif;
  font-weight: 400;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
@media (min-width: 1850px) {
  .lp-huawei {
    max-width: 1920px;
  }
}

.lp-huawei img {
  margin: auto;
  width: 100%;
}

.lp-huawei * {
  line-height: normal;
}

.lp-huawei sup {
  font-size: 50%;
}

.lp-huawei b {
  font-weight: 600;
}

.lp-huawei *[onclick] {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.huawei-cta {
  background-color: white;
  width: 145px;
  margin: auto;
  display: block;
  color: black;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 500;
  transition: 0.4s ease-in-out;
  letter-spacing: 0.2px;
  padding: 4px 0 6px 0;
  border-radius: 50px;
  border: 1px solid var(--huawei-blue);
}
@media (min-width: 960px) {
  .huawei-cta {
    font-size: 19px;
    padding: 4px 0 6px 0;
    width: 190px;
  }
}
.huawei-cta.active {
  border-color: var(--huawei-purple);
}

.br-mob {
  display: block;
}
@media (min-width: 960px) {
  .br-mob {
    display: none;
  }
}

.br-desk {
  display: none;
}
@media (min-width: 960px) {
  .br-desk {
    display: block;
  }
}

.huawei-bloc-code {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  width: -moz-fit-content;
  width: fit-content;
  padding: 4px 20px;
  border-radius: 50px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 18px;
  background-color: var(--huawei-blue);
  color: white;
  transition: 0.5s ease-in-out;
}
@media (min-width: 960px) {
  .huawei-bloc-code {
    padding: 4px 13px;
  }
}
.huawei-bloc-code.active {
  background-color: var(--huawei-purple);
}
.huawei-bloc-code > .huawei-code {
  font-family: "Huawei-light";
}
@media (min-width: 960px) {
  .huawei-bloc-code > .huawei-code {
    font-size: 18px;
  }
}
.huawei-bloc-code > img {
  width: 10px;
  margin: 0 0 0 5px;
}
@media (min-width: 960px) {
  .huawei-bloc-code > img {
    width: 15px;
  }
}

.huawei-code-confirm {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 3;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  background-color: white;
  color: black;
  transition: 0.3s ease-in-out;
  padding-top: 0px;
  border-radius: 5px;
}
.huawei-code-confirm > p {
  font-size: 12px;
  margin: 0;
}
.huawei-code-confirm.actif {
  opacity: 1;
}

.swiper-button-next:after,
.swiper-button-prev:after {
  display: none !important;
}

.swiper-button-next,
.swiper-button-prev {
  background: none !important;
}

.huawei-header {
  height: 90vh;
  max-height: 750px;
  position: relative;
}
@media (max-width: 374px) {
  .huawei-header {
    height: 100vh;
  }
}
@media (min-width: 960px) {
  .huawei-header {
    height: 700px;
  }
}
@media (min-width: 1280px) {
  .huawei-header {
    height: 630px;
  }
}
@media (min-width: 1400px) {
  .huawei-header {
    height: 680px;
  }
}
@media (min-width: 1850px) {
  .huawei-header {
    height: 850px;
    max-height: unset;
  }
}
.huawei-header > .huawei-header-background {
  position: absolute;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
.huawei-header > .huawei-header-background > video {
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  -o-object-fit: cover;
     object-fit: cover;
}
@media (min-width: 960px) {
  .huawei-header > .huawei-header-background > video {
    -o-object-position: top;
       object-position: top;
  }
}
.huawei-header > .huawei-header-background > .huawei-logo {
  position: absolute;
  top: 30px;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: 145px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  visibility: hidden;
  opacity: 0;
}
.huawei-header > .huawei-header-background > .huawei-logo.active {
  transition: 0.5s ease-in-out;
  visibility: visible;
  opacity: 1;
}
.huawei-header > .huawei-header-offer {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 15px;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: 95%;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background-color: rgba(34, 34, 34, 0.35);
  color: rgb(239, 237, 237);
  border-radius: 20px;
  min-width: 330px;
  padding-top: 8px;
  box-shadow: inset 2px 3px 2.5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.51), inset -2px -3px 2.5px rgba(234, 234, 234, 0.25);
  max-width: 360px;
  max-height: 40px;
  overflow: hidden;
  backdrop-filter: blur(7px);
}
@media (max-width: 374px) {
  .huawei-header > .huawei-header-offer {
    bottom: -20px;
  }
}
@media (min-width: 960px) {
  .huawei-header > .huawei-header-offer {
    bottom: 30px;
    max-width: unset;
    min-width: unset;
    width: -moz-fit-content;
    width: fit-content;
    padding: 20px 75px 0 75px;
    max-height: 65px;
  }
}
.huawei-header > .huawei-header-offer.active {
  transition: 0.5s ease-in-out;
  max-height: 500px;
  overflow: visible;
  padding-top: 15px;
}
.huawei-header > .huawei-header-offer.active > p:first-child {
  transition: 0.5s ease-in-out;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}
.huawei-header > .huawei-header-offer > p:first-child {
  font-family: "Huawei-medium";
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-size: 17px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
@media (min-width: 960px) {
  .huawei-header > .huawei-header-offer > p:first-child {
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    font-size: 21px;
  }
}
.huawei-header > .huawei-header-offer > p:nth-child(2) {

  font-size: 11px;
}
@media (min-width: 960px) {

    font-size: 13px;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
  }
}

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

  font-size: 45px;

}
@media (min-width: 960px) {

  }
}

}

}
@media (min-width: 960px) {

@media (min-width: 960px) {
  .huawei-header > .huawei-header-offer > div:nth-child(3) > div:nth-child(2) > p:nth-child(2) {
